notes: Pins 5-12 are N.C. but must go to ground (here named GND so connecting GND grounds them).
No other crystal: the TCXO is inside. Keep the package away from heat sources; avoid traces under it on the top layer.
RST has its own 50k pull-up: a push-button to GND resets, no external resistor.
Also in the datasheet's circuit: BT1 CR2032 (backup cell (a holder: CR2032_HOLDER_SMD)) between VBAT and GND.
I2C address 0x68 (fixed; shared with DS1307 and MPU-6050 at its default address: not on the same bus). The registers also hold a temperature reading (0.25 °C).
